conversation.user: I just want to renovate one cold, damp bedroom, about 300 sq. ft. of wall area, to stop mold. Can I use this inside, and will it eat up my room space?
conversation.assistant:
You can absolutely use an interior hempcrete retrofit to stop that cold dampness and mold! We typically recommend a slim 2.5 to 3-inch interior layer for this, which requires about 2.5 to 3 m³ of material installed over furring strips with simple hand-tamping. It only takes up a very modest amount of your room space while working wonders to regulate moisture and warmth. Just keep in mind these calculator numbers are planning estimates, not stamped engineering advice. 

What type of exterior wall do you currently have in that bedroom?
